verdict.rationale: There is some audit-adjacent tooling — webhook payloads are HMAC-SHA256 signed for verification, and appointment.completed/notarization events are emitted for real-time tracking — plus a gated 'Compliance API' mentioned for Enterprise plans, but no documentation describes a tamper-evident audit trail or a formal completion certificate issued per signed document. Missing for 10: explicit tamper-evident audit log/ledger per document, description of a 'completion certificate' artifact, and any compliance-API detail beyond the fact it exists.
